author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 12/12/2018: BILI, PVTL, NTES, PLAB, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +1.91%
AAPL: +1.29%
IBM: +1.40%
CSCO: +1.49%
GOOG: +1.32%
Tech stocks gain pre-market Wednesday.
In other sector news:
(+) Bilibili ( BILI ) was more than 2% higher after it announced an agreement to acquire major assets from Chinese comic platform NetEase ( NTES ) Comics.
(+) Pivotal Software ( PVTL ) was slightly up more than 1% its adjusted net loss narrowed to $0.05 in Q3 from $0.13 a year earlier, a smaller loss than analysts' expectations of $0.08 per share in a Capital IQ poll.
(-) Photronics ( PLAB ) was down more than 1% as it reported financial results for fiscal Q4, with better-than-expected revenue and earnings that matched analysts' forecasts; it also provided guidance for fiscal Q1 just short of Street estimates.
